instruction: Get every slide title from Dickinson_Slides.pptx and save the list, with one title per line, to 'titles.txt' on the Desktop.

Verified 9 slides with titles: 'Presentation Title' (slides 1-3), 'GraphTitle' (slide 4), 'Chart Title' (slide 5), 'List Title' (slide 6), 'Slide Title' (slide 7), 'Type image caption here.' (slide 8), 'Page Title' (slide 9). Evaluator reads text file and compares each line against expected titles.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads text file and extracts lines as a list with proper UTF-8 decoding and whitespace handling
Metric correctly compares result list against expected titles with appropriate whitespace normalization
